title: Finite supported module units through the abelian comparison
statement: Let T be a locally Noetherian quasi-compact scheme, let i: Z → T be the closed immersion with quasi-compact open complement j: U → T, and let A be a finite, possibly noncommutative ring. Set B = Z/addOrderOf(1_A), with its canonical constant-ring sheaves. Assume [lem-exc-proetale-closed-essential-image] for those B-sheaves: closed essential image is equivalent to zero open restriction and the closed units of supported objects are invertible. For the specified left-module functors and normalized units: (1) if j_A^* N is zero, then the actual closed unit N → i_{A,*} i_A^* N is invertible; (2) j_A^* i_{A,*} M is zero for every A_Z-module sheaf M; (3) j_A^* of the actual open unit N → j_{A,*} j_A^* N is invertible for every A_T-module sheaf N. This is a statement solely about module sheaves, before formation of kernels or complexes.

source.place: Supported kernel identification, coefficient transfer and restricted open unit (Steps 1–3 of lem-exc-proetale-supported-kernel-complex)

proof.text: Apply [lem-exc-proetale-finite-scalar-unit-comparison] to the identity ring homomorphism A → A for i and j. Its eS comparison identifies the underlying abelian sheaf of each specified module pullback with the abelian inverse image, and huS identifies the module adjunction unit with the abelian unit. Forgetting modules reflects isomorphisms and detects zero objects. No change of coefficient presentation is needed.

For a module N with zero open pullback, use the open comparison to obtain zero abelian open restriction. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-abelian-closed-support]. Its invertible abelian closed unit is the forgotten module unit followed by the image of the invertible comparison. Cancel that comparison and reflect isomorphisms. The adjunction supplied by the scalar comparison and finiteModuleAdjunction have the same right adjoint; unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app intertwines their units by an invertible map, so the actual finiteModuleAdjunction closed unit is invertible. This proves the first clause without using the retained commutative-coefficient hypothesis.

The complementary ranges are disjoint. The proved source isZero_openImmersionRestriction_lowerStar applies with arbitrary closed map i and open j: the abelian direct-image sections on the open are sections on empty base changes, hence zero by the empty covering. Transport by upperStarIsoOpenImmersionRestriction and then eS for j. The underlying sheaf of module pushforward is definitionally abelian direct image. Its open module pullback therefore has zero underlying sheaf. Apply the faithful forgetful functor to its identity, use map_id and map_zero, and infer that the module identity is zero. This proves the second clause.

The abelian open direct image is fully faithful by the proved openImmersionRestrictionLowerStarAdjunction counit. For the module adjunction supplied by the comparison, take the abelian mate of the forgotten module unit. Its composite with the image of eS is the abelian unit, so this mate equals eS inverse and is invertible. Naturality of homEquiv and the right triangle identity identify its composite with the forgotten module counit with the invertible abelian counit. Cancel the mate and reflect invertibility to the module counit. Thus module pushforward is fully faithful. For the actual finiteModuleAdjunction, the triangle identity now implies that its left adjoint sends its unit to an isomorphism. This proves the third clause.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteSupportedModuleUnits
    [IsLocallyNoetherian T] [CompactSpace T]
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j]
    (hU : Set.range j = (Set.range i)ᶜ)
    (_hB : ∀ N : Scheme.proEtaleRingModules T
        (Scheme.proEtaleConstantRing T (ULift.{u} (ZMod (addOrderOf (1 : A))))),
      ((Scheme.proEtaleConstantRingPushforward
          (ULift.{u} (ZMod (addOrderOf (1 : A)))) i).essImage N ↔
        IsZero ((Scheme.proEtaleConstantRingPullback
          (ULift.{u} (ZMod (addOrderOf (1 : A)))) j).obj N)) ∧
      (IsZero ((Scheme.proEtaleConstantRingPullback
          (ULift.{u} (ZMod (addOrderOf (1 : A)))) j).obj N) →
        IsIso ((Scheme.proEtaleConstantRingAdjunction
          (ULift.{u} (ZMod (addOrderOf (1 : A)))) i).unit.app N))) :
    (∀ N : FiniteCoefficientModules T A,
      IsZero ((finiteCoefficientModulePullback j A).obj N) →
        IsIso ((finiteModuleAdjunction i A).unit.app N)) ∧
    (∀ M : FiniteCoefficientModules Z A,
      IsZero ((finiteCoefficientModulePullback j A).obj
        ((finiteModulePushforward i A).obj M))) ∧
    (∀ N : FiniteCoefficientModules T A,
      IsIso ((finiteCoefficientModulePullback j A).map
        ((finiteModuleAdjunction j A).unit.app N)))
